limits.source: Yamaha YNCA specification: at least 100 ms between two commands (ynca-python protocol.py) — the command gate's YNCA spacing

own cap: one YNCA connection per receiver, a new one only after the reconnect backoff (1 s doubling to 60 s, at most 20 % earlier — lifecycle/reconnect-strategy.ts) — at most 7 attempts in a minute; measured 6 through the outage and hang suites, 2026-10-07
own cap: requests to one receiver run one at a time through its command gate (Y-15); measured 40 within a second during a read-in against fixtures that answer at once, 2026-10-07
own cap: one read-in plus the steady polls (XML status every 60 s, MusicCast liveness every 60 s and keepalive every 5 min); measured 67 within a minute through the outage and hang suites, 2026-10-07

own cap: one search sends its M-SEARCH three times, one second apart, on every chosen interface (network-search.ts SSDP_SEARCH_BURST), and a new search follows at the earliest after 20 s (main.ts REDISCOVER_QUICK_INTERVAL_MS) — 12 covers four interfaces
